notes: «- يعني ابن أبي ليلى -» is an editor gloss and is left out; Ibn Abi Layla is the speaker and last link
«شهدت حذيفة استسقى» is an action in the scene: Hudhayfa is not a link
«فذكره بمعنى حديث ابن عكيم عن حذيفة» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
«أبي» («حدثنا أبي») is not named in the text: a relation link
